This is the markup template, not the page. Open index.html in the root of the repository instead: it is generated from this file, with the stylesheet and engine inlined.

Resonance Engine

—

What you are looking at

many thousands of little metronomes, each swinging at its own speed and tuned by position — low on the left, high on the right. Each one nudges its four neighbours, so a disturbance you make spreads outward as a wave. Bright means recently set in motion.

Drag anywhere. You will paint a bright trail and hear notes; higher up the screen is higher pitch. Try Burst to set every cell going at once.

The Order figure stays near zero and that is correct — the grid spans many pitches, so it organises into local waves rather than one unison. Local order is the number that responds to Coupling.

Tap Enable audio — browsers require a gesture before sound.

Drag to conduct · tap Hide for a full-size field

Transport

Physics

Coupling is how hard each metronome pulls on its neighbours. Raise it and local groups lock together sooner and hold longer after you drag; lower it and they drift apart faster. It does not make the whole grid agree — the pitch spread across the screen is wider than the coupling can bridge, so Order stays near zero at every setting. Watch the waves glow instead of the number.

How to play

  • Drag on the field to push waves through it.
  • Drag with the button held to also sound notes along the pitch axis.
  • Right-click drag to damp the field instead of exciting it.
  • Home row asdf… / number row q2w3e… play scale degrees.
  • Space pause · B burst · C silence · M mutate · N reseed · R reset
